resolved_conflicts.explanation: The GSA auction closed in October 2013 (Forest Lookouts index; FLA 2014 report; firelookout.com says auctioned in 2013). The Idaho Fire Lookouts entry gives 2014 for the sale, but its removal date matches the October 2014 removal in the other sources.

notes_for_editor: Disputed: first lookout 1933 (firelookout.com, Gazette Record) vs 1936 (Idaho Fire Lookouts; Forest Lookouts index citing Kresek); R-6 cab 1974 (Idaho Fire Lookouts, index) vs 1975 (firelookout.com, Gazette Record). Staffing: the Idaho Fire Lookouts staff list stops at 1980, while firelookout.com and the Gazette say the Forest Service staffed it until 1995. Land: firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the index give St. Joe National Forest, but the Gazette Record says state land; the story says so and does not settle it. Record location (47.24248, -116.03597) not checked: firelookout.com says 20 miles southeast of St. Maries; by my rough arithmetic the point is more east-southeast of St. Maries at roughly 25 miles, so please check. Idaho Fire Lookouts points to the owners' Facebook page for the rebuild; I did not read it, and I could not confirm where the rebuilt tower stands. Do not confuse with the CDA-region Huckleberry Mountain lookout (cda-region/huckleberry-mountain-lookout, a 1920s crow's nest and 60-ft pole tower, removed), which is a different site. Buyers are private individuals; not named.
